title: Overkey
description: Overkey is a Minecraft mod that displays your mouse clicks and keyboard inputs (W, A, S, and D) on screen in real time. It is commonly used by players to showcase their movements and actions during gameplay.
body: ![showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e126449918a9051f485b9dd1ef519913f9e8c05.png)Overkey is a Minecraft mod that displays your mouse clicks and keyboard inputs (W, A, S, and D) on screen in real time. It is commonly used by players to showcase their movements and actions during gameplay.
